channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 21 sources (18 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: Mellum2.1 Instruct Is Out, Bringing Faster Answers for Coding Agents
item.description: JetBrains releases a lighter sibling of Mellum2.1, aimed at sub-agents, tool-call loops, and chat, with quicker responses.

item.title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
item.description: Scientists discuss how far AI agents should go in research and which lines must not be crossed, drawing a reference boundary for agent autonomy.

item.title: Building a software factory around human attention
item.description: The Kiro team shares a year of practice: agents run the full development cycle from discovery to release and monitoring on their own, with people stepping in only where a real decision is needed.

item.title: v2.4.2
item.description: Open source AI coding agent OpenCode ships maintenance release v2.4.2, with no detailed changelog published this time.

item.title: v0.26.0
item.description: Agents SDK 0.26.0 brings the GPT-Live demo up to version 1.1 and fixes version compatibility in the external provider example plus a Docker resource limit.

item.title: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
item.description: IBM Research built a voice assistant for Indian farmers on the open-source CUGA agent harness: ask aloud in a local language and it searches an English farming handbook, then answers by voice in that same language, with multilingual embeddings solving the cross-lingual retrieval problem.

item.title: v2.75.0 (2026-11-25)
item.description: This release tightens instruction authority for workspace files, keeping RepoContext, Skills and Memory content below operator level, and adds a lowest_authority_under setting.

item.title: Release v0.71.1
item.description: A patch release that backports a fix into the v0.71.0 line to address an issue in that version.

item.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
item.description: GPT-6 can design protein structures and sequences through reasoning and code alone, with lab tests showing signs of binding across five targets.
Claude Code 2.1.332 brings in beta support for skills served by MCP servers, plus a PreSkillShellCommand hook that can refuse inline scripts before a skill or command runs.

item.title: v2.74.0 (2026-11-24)
item.description: Pydantic AI 2.74.0 adds a computer-use tool contract to the core, letting agents call ComputerTool directly to operate a computer.

item.title: The Agent Lake
item.description: LangSmith's Agent Lake gathers every trace agents produce, surfaces the high-signal ones, and converts them into fixes and fine-tuning data.

item.title: Release v1.0.0-preview.2
item.description: Qwen Code v1.0.0-preview.2 adds Qwen4-Max to the subscription catalog (1M context, image and video input), shows a reset countdown when credits run out, and adds an /upgrade command that opens the plans page.

item.title: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
item.description: Hill-climbing tuning squeezes faster Inkling 2 Mini inference out of a single RTX PRO 6000.
Thread links in search results and transcripts now reopen saved chats and nested agents, and Tab completes slash-command arguments.

item.title: Release v0.72.0-preview.0
item.description: Gemini CLI ships v0.72.0-preview.0, fixing nested .gitignore handling and Windows home paths, resuming the most recently active session, and adding authentication and input checks to the A2A server.

item.title: v1.107.11 (2026-11-24)
item.description: A small patch update on the Pydantic AI 1.x line, focused on routine fixes.

item.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
item.description: Google Antigravity gains Mass Spec Skills, helping scientists read tandem mass spectra and work out molecular structures from the data.

item.title: v2.72.0 (2026-11-23)
item.description: Pydantic AI 2.72.0 flags requests aimed at models Anthropic or OpenAI have already retired, and adds agent instruction overrides, realtime voice instructions, and aliased tool arguments.

item.title: v2.73.0 (2026-11-23)
item.description: Version 2.73.0 warns developers if they call a model that Anthropic or OpenAI has phased out, and refines how cached inputs are handled for OpenAI Responses.
